title: Vanishing of the cohomology of the sum of the constant sheaves supported at the closed points
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that the cohomology of the direct sum over the closed points of a smooth curve of the constant sheaf Z pushed forward from each point vanishes in positive degrees (statement lines 11051-11055, with the standing set-up delivered verbatim as a context span from lines 10937-10941). The proof reduces the direct sum to a single point through the commutation of cohomology with colimits (proof lines 11057-11060), uses that the inclusion of a closed point is finite and applies the Leray spectral sequence to identify the cohomology with that of the constant sheaf on the point (proof lines 11060-11065), and concludes by the vanishing on the spectrum of an algebraically closed field (proof lines 11065-11068). The non-formal content is the reduction to a single point. The claim is H2: three short steps, each written out.
